preconditions: Explicit gameplay authorization, prepared disposable CodexTest, observed real UI action plan, one operation at a time, native owner/host bridge sessions and optional independent foreign-viewer session. No game launch, setup grants, resets, receipts or service calls are made by this driver.
cases: Placed enqueue returns exact detached attachments through the saved owner and native station pair, with exact final rich owner grids and terminal cleanup.
Placed cancel before output returns the original source once and retires its native queue group; repeated observation/reconnect retains the same original.
Placed final completion settles exact original native output, tools, grouped queue and recipient bonus before releasing custody.
Foreign native viewer introduces completion for a different original recipient; independent owner and authoritative host prove the same immutable source and saved terminal.
start stopAfterOriginal records the actual original without certifying completion; resume follows that operation after operator-owned reconnect; verify requires a genuine new native process session.
Run offline/listen and independently connected remote owner, plus dedicated with dedicated=true; unavailable topology remains NOT_RUN.
limitations: Authored only. Read-only native evidence and real-input driver do not create fault injection or establish runtime success. StopAfterOriginal is an observation checkpoint, not a forced pause. Exact rich after-image checks require no unrelated inventory/station changes during the prepared single-operation flow. Existing method cohorts cover bounded admission/refusal boundaries separately.
